subject: Request: limited PT extracts + redaction matrix for procurement review
messages:
From: Alice Singh <alice.singh@prospectco.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Derek Huang <derek.huang@prospectco.com>, procurement@prospectco.com
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for PT report extracts and redaction approach for procurement

Hi Jonas,

As part of our procurement security review at ProspectCo we need to review your most recent penetration test materials. Our procurement and InfoSec teams have the following asks:

- A redacted executive summary of the pen test (we don't need full exploit details).
- A redaction matrix that maps redacted items to the reason (sensitive proof-of-concept, customer data, third-party agreements).
- A limited "evidence extract" package containing non-sensitive vulnerability metadata (IDs, severity, affected components) and a short remediation status per finding.

Can Redwood provide the above under a mutual NDA? If possible, Procurement would like a single zip with the exec summary (PDF), redaction matrix (XLSX), and evidence extracts (ZIP). We also need a short statement we can include in our security questionnaire indicating whether high/critical items are remediated or in progress.

Timeline: procurement is aiming to complete vendor risk checks within two weeks. Please let me know if that timeline is feasible. If you need a formal NDA, we can sign one — happy to route via DocuSign.

Thanks,
Alice Singh
Security Engineer, ProspectCo
alice.singh@prospectco.com

--
Note: Please treat any exchanged pen test material as confidential.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Singh <alice.singh@prospectco.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for PT report extracts and redaction approach for procurement

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. We can accommodate this request. Quick answers up front:

- We can share a redacted executive summary (PDF) plus a redaction matrix that explains what was redacted and why.
- We can package an "evidence extract" zip containing per-finding metadata (IDs, severity, short description, affected components) and a remediation status column (verified / patch applied / mitigation in place / in progress). We will not include exploit PoC details or customer-specific data.
- We require a mutual NDA before we transmit any pen test artifacts. We can either sign your NDA or send a mutual standard one.

I've looped in Neha from our security team to scope the exact extract contents and propose the redaction rules. If Procurement can indicate whether they need verification (i.e., independent re-test or self-attested remediation) that will help us prepare the right artifacts.

Tentative timeline: once NDA is agreed, we can deliver the redacted exec summary + redaction matrix within 2 business days and the evidence extract package within 4 business days. If procurement needs an accelerated schedule, flag it and we'll prioritize.

Next steps:
1) Which NDA do you prefer (your template or our mutual NDA)?
2) Confirm whether verified remediation is required.
3) Provide the list of recipients and the email to route the DocuSign.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: scope & redaction plan for ProspectCo PT material

Jonas / Marissa —

Summary of what Security can produce if ProspectCo agrees to our mutual NDA:

Artifacts we will prepare (example filenames are placeholders):
- exec_summary_redacted.pdf (Executive summary with all PoC steps removed; affected components and severity preserved).
- redaction_matrix_ProspectCo.xlsx (mapping: original section / redaction type / rationale / stakeholder note).
- evidence_extracts_v1.zip (CSV per-finding: finding_id, cvss, title, component, first_seen, remediation_status, remediation_notes).

Redaction rules (high level):
- Remove exploit proof-of-concept code, exact reproduction steps, and any customer-identifying logs or data.
- Preserve non-sensitive metadata: severity, component, high-level description suitable for risk assessment.
- For third-party vendor issues, redact vendor PII per contract obligations.

Remediation status summary (to include in the extract CSV):
- High / Critical: 3 findings — 1 verified remediated (CVE-2026-1423, fix deployed 2027-02-11), 1 mitigated with compensating controls (in progress for verification), 1 scheduled (target 2027-04-01).
- Medium: 6 findings — majority remediated or scheduled within normal release cadence.

We will not share raw logs or exploit artifacts. If ProspectCo requires independent verification we can discuss an agreed scope for a focused retest (additional SOW).

Attachments: we will include the three files above as stubs for the procurement package once NDA is in place. Legal review may request specific language in the redaction matrix for our sensitive categories — Marissa, please advise on minimum NDA terms (mutual confidentiality, no distribution, destruction clause).

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

From: Alice Singh <alice.singh@prospectco.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Derek Huang <derek.huang@prospectco.com>, procurement@prospectco.com
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for PT report extracts and redaction approach for procurement

Thanks Jonas / Neha — this sounds good and aligns with our needs. A few clarifying items:

- Procurement requires a column in the redaction matrix indicating whether remediation was "verified by vendor" or "requires independent validation". Can you include a short verification status per high/critical finding?
- For procurement documentation, we also need a one-line attestation from Redwood stating whether the exec summary reflects the most recent pen test (date) and whether the high/critical issues are still outstanding as of the date of delivery.
- We'll send our standard mutual NDA draft via DocuSign; if Redwood prefers to send your template instead, we can review.

If all looks good we'll route the DocuSign to procurement@prospectco.com and derek.huang@prospectco.com. Timeline: signing within 48 hours would keep us on track.

Regards,
Alice

Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for PT report extracts and redaction approach for procurement

Hi Alice — thanks for the confirm. Per next steps:

1) Marissa from Legal will review your NDA if you send it; otherwise we are sharing our mutual NDA via DocuSign (link below).
2) Security will include a "verification_status" column in the redaction matrix with vendor-attested statuses. If ProspectCo requires independent validation, we'll note that as "independent verification required" and propose an SOW.
3) Once NDA is fully executed we will upload the following package to a secure Drive link (access granted to the email addresses you specify): exec_summary_redacted.pdf, redaction_matrix_ProspectCo.xlsx, evidence_extracts_v1.zip.

DocuSign link (Redwood mutual NDA): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/abcdef-Redwood-ProspectCo-NDA
(If you send your template, please route to marissa.cole@redwood.ai)

Delivery timeline after signed NDA: exec summary + redaction matrix within 2 business days; evidence extracts within 4 business days. We will include the one-line attestation you requested with the package.

If procurement needs the materials sooner, let me know and we'll escalate.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
